job.description:
I’m looking for an experienced e-commerce marketplace specialist to implement and optimize our marketplace integrations for my luxury fashion brand.

This is an implementation project.

Our Shopify store is already live, and our Instagram/Facebook Shop is connected. I need an expert to complete the remaining marketplace setup, upload product assets, and ensure all sales channels are fully operational.

Requirements

* TikTok Shop expertise
* TikTok Shop compliance & approval experience
* Amazon Seller Central experience
* Meta Commerce Manager experience
* Experience with fashion/apparel or e-commerce brands preferred
* Must work within our existing Shopify store (no redesign)

Scope Includes

Shopify

* Upload additional product images (including 3D photos)
* Update product descriptions where needed
* Ensure all products are marketplace-ready

Instagram / Facebook Shop

* Audit existing Meta Commerce Manager setup
* Resolve catalog synchronization issues (if any)
* Verify products sync correctly with Shopify

TikTok Shop

* Identify why our TikTok Shop application was not approved
* Resolve compliance and verification issues
* Complete TikTok Shop setup
* Connect TikTok Shop with Shopify
* Verify product synchronization
* Configure shipping, taxes, and order synchronization

Amazon

* Set up Amazon Seller Central
* Create Amazon Storefront
* Upload product listings
* Configure parent/child variations (sizes and colors)
* Optimize listings
* Connect inventory with Shopify where appropriate

Product Listings

Verify all products include:

* Images
* Descriptions
* Variants
* Pricing
* Inventory
* Collections

Ensure products remain synchronized across Shopify, Meta, TikTok Shop, and Amazon.

Deliverables

* TikTok Shop approved and fully operational
* Shopify integrated with TikTok Shop
* Instagram/Facebook Shop fully synchronized
* Amazon Storefront configured
* Product listings uploaded and optimized
* Inventory syncing correctly across all channels
* Documentation of any recommendations or remaining issues

Please Include

* Examples of Shopify marketplace integrations you’ve completed
* Experience resolving TikTok Shop approval issues
* Experience with fashion, apparel, or lingerie brands
* Estimated timeline
* Estimated hours
* Any recommendations after reviewing this project

Budget: Hourly (open to fixed-price proposals)

siblingJobs.description: Looking for a reels editor/content manager to grow our Instagram through strong short-form content.
